name: bipartite_check
author: 3c8c3c69
description: Checks whether a graph is bipartite: whether its nodes can be split into two groups so that every edge joins the two groups and no edge lies inside a group. Use it for questions like 'can the nodes be split into two groups with no links inside a group?', 'is this a two-sided network such as students and projects?' or 'can these be scheduled in two rounds with no conflicts?'. Works on undirected and directed graphs (direction is ignored); weights are ignored. If bipartite, returns the size and first top_k nodes of each side, the number of separate parts, and an attribute that matches the sides if one exists; each side is registered as a subgraph (result_graph_id is the larger side). If not bipartite, returns an odd cycle that proves it, registered as a subgraph.

graph_id.description: Id of the graph to check.

top_k.description: How many nodes of each side to list (each side's subgraph always holds all of them).
